What happened to him?''"<br />"''Feez joined the McGrrrr Gang and asked me to bring the money to you.''"<br />"''Second, when I gave you the coordinates to the Black Hole sector so you could infiltrate the McGrrrr Gang and make sure no harm came to anyone on the ''Hasty Harpy'', I told you to bring backup. The '''Black Hole sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], close to the realm of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. It was named for the [[Unidentified black hole|black hole]] that prevented [[Hyperspace/Legends|interstellar]] travel in and out of the sector.
